topic: Unit Testing with JUnit and Mockito
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose of unit testing in Java applications.
Create test structures using JUnit assertions and lifecycle methods.
Use mocks to isolate dependencies during unit testing.

activities.title: Test Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the structure of a unit test.

content.concept: A unit test prepares inputs, executes the target behavior, and verifies the expected result with assertions.

content.concept: The Arrange-Act-Assert pattern separates test setup, execution, and verification into clear stages.

activities.instruction: Choose the assertion for each scenario.

content.concept: JUnit provides assertions for checking equality, truth values, nullability, exceptions, and other expected outcomes.
